data.title: myCar: Car Widgets & Dashboard
data.description:
Turn Your Car Screen Into Something Personal

Your car screen doesn’t have to be just maps and menus. With myCar, it becomes yours.

Bring Your Style to Your Car Screen
myCar lets you customize your car screen with what actually matters to you. Add your favorite couple photos, choose icons you like, or even display fun GIFs. It’s your space, make it feel like it.

A Car Dashboard You’ll Actually Enjoy Looking At
Instead of the same standard layout every day, create a look that reflects your mood and personality. Whether it’s a photo that makes you smile or a clean, minimal setup, it’s all up to you.

Add Motion, Not Just Static
Why stop at photos? Bring your screen to life with GIFs that move and catch your eye. It’s a small touch that makes a big difference every time you get in the car.

Quick, Simple, Personal
No complicated setup. Just choose what you want to see and it’s there
• Couple photos and memories
• Custom icons
• Animated GIFs

Start with a Sound You Love
Tap to hear your favorite startup sound and set the tone before you even begin driving. From powerful engine sounds to smooth electric tones, pick what feels right.

Why You’ll Love myCar
Because your car is part of your daily life, and it should feel like it belongs to you. myCar adds personality, emotion, and a bit of fun to every drive.

Make your car screen yours
Download myCar and turn every drive into something more personal.

Premium Mode

Upgrade to unlock advanced customization options, enhanced layouts, and extended tools for a more personalized dashboard experience.

Privacy and Security

Your data stays on your device whenever possible.
No personal information is sold or shared with third parties. Data is only used to support app functionality and improvements.

Privacy Policy: https://karmatech.ee/car-connect/privacy-policy/
